question: Can a fixed-capacity tokenless numerical shared causal core actually change its synapses while preserving multiple mutually conflicting learned context laws, without full per-context model copies, and outperform matched conventional Bayesian and sparse-replay reference models on unseen action consequences and whole-process cost?
hypothesis: A directly learned 128-bit shared causal base, sixteen independently inferred 2-flip context adapters, and bounded XOR compensations after genuine contradictory shared-base updates will preserve prior context predictions without full per-context snapshots. Matched conventional sparse delta and exact Bayesian references may reproduce the identical result; a tie is NO_GO for unique scientific benefit.
predecessor_evidence: FKP08 draft PR #1099, source-qualified 81d60026c066c1160aa60559170c06cf01677353, DEV 0.75952 vs exact Bayesian 0.79289 and same-info delta 0.75952. Its original shared base never changed, versions only appended patch IDs.

ST9 draft PR #1087 already qualifies single within-family 4→8 causal representation repair + public replay; matched independent active GF2 controls tie. It does NOT test mutually conflicting retained context laws after changing the globally shared synapses.

NKR03 draft PR #1096 establishes opt-in native verified-exception intake and conservative abstention on unfamiliar native contexts; equally informed lookup matches and trained symbolic/MLP can outperform.
Issue #1088 accepts only independently qualified beneficial native integration; this proposal is isolated external research and no model authority.

inputs.name: Original FKP09 source design (synthetic, no external dataset)
inputs.source: SHA256 of the exact canonical UTF-8 FKP09-SRC-V1 protocol string defined in frozen_design.source_spec. Git source/test blobs will be pinned before any DEV outcome.

seeds.fixture: 850..853, 4 permitted fixture contexts for focused pre-DEV unit tests only
seeds.development: 900..915, 16 original DEV context laws for one original first-use study only
seeds.protected_primary: 1900..1963, owner-private HMAC key, NEVER instantiate in CI/conversation
seeds.negative: 2900..2915 protected owner-private alternate context law, do not instantiate
seeds.global_stages: 0..3, 128 genuine onehot base readouts per stage; stage 4 is public fixture-only 16-bit catastrophic rebase negative, must reject atomically

frozen_design.split: 128 binary causal components. Original global source base is one hidden HMAC-derived 128-bit vector. Each context has a hidden two-bit XOR edit of this original base. A public intervention action is a 128-bit bitmask; its observed binary consequence is the exact parity of activated causal weights. Each new context has 128 public candidates and 128 disjoint held intervention masks drawn from public deterministic SHA-256 streams before outcomes, with 32 paid context actions per arm. New base global revisions 1..3 each flip exactly two source-private causal components, learned by 128 freshly observed basis consequences per stage. Context causal laws remain physically constant when shared base changes. Do not supply secret pair IDs, hidden source base or protected owner key to models.
frozen_design.original_action_budgets: 16 contexts ×32 real context interventions=512, plus four global base stages ×128 actual onehot interventions=512. Total 1024 actual source action-consequence pairs per arm. Held:16 contexts ×128 withheld masks=2048 original unseen consequences per arm and same held predictions audited after 3 global updates, for 8192 retention checks. A 12-action reference may use only the first 12 of each original 32 paid context actions for identifiability, not an extra source call.
frozen_design.candidate: A tokenless direct 128-bit numerical shared core, 16 context-specific adapter masks of maximum eight *indices* each, and sparse compensated XOR rebase. After source-valid new shared core, update the shared 128-bit core IN PLACE and XOR the observed core difference into each previously acquired context adapter. Stored context predictions must remain bit-identical before and after all three actual shared-core updates. Storage budget: 16 bytes base +16 contexts×8 unsigned-byte adapter index slots =144 bytes raw, with explicit schema/checksum/metadata counted separately. Fail closed atomically if an adapter needs >8 indices.
controls: B: independent exact conventional full per-context 128-bit causal masks, reconstructed only from the SAME public base and context observations, with no direct secret rule identities; fully trained exact table, 256 bytes raw.

C: equal-information, identical-capacity conventional sparse delta encoding of learned base and context adapter indices, with same rebase, expected EXACT tie in predictions and bytes. This tie invalidates any unique native superiority claim.

D: independent exact Bayesian posterior over all 8128 two-bit context edits on the same first 32 original context actions, with uniform prior and 128-bit source public base; marginal predictions for true held actions, strongest inference reference.
E: frozen 12-action best-compatible/majority posterior reference for original source-headroom audit; held labels are source-owner only after all predictions sealed.
F: naive overwrite shared base with no context compensation; weaker interference diagnostic, not strongest baseline.
G: owner-only out-of-family stage-4 global 16-bit shift on fixture context, with >8-index capacity overrun; atomic reject, no silent corrupted prior model.
frozen_design.ordering: Commit prereg alone before source/method and original outcome. Fully pin exact source/test SHA/tree and fixture-only qualification BEFORE any DEV first-use. Original DEV creates 16 contexts, pays 128 real base onehot observations at each of four stages and 32 genuine context interventions per context. Original 2048 held action outcomes revealed only after A-F model predictions have been sealed. After each base update, all prior contexts must still predict bit-identically on original held masks; source only reveals new global basis observations. Stage4 shock uses fixture-only data and must be rejected atomically.
frozen_design.data_budget: 1024 genuine historical/current binary source observations per arm (512 context, 512 four-stage global base), 2048 held outcomes and 8192 sealed retention comparisons. Same source-pool and action count to all qualifying arms, no relabeling reused data as virgin.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 stdlib only. 8128 possible pair indices (choose(128,2)) fitted against 32 context observations. Strong Bayes exact marginal posterior must examine same 8128 hypotheses. Report source+training+fit+rebasing+predict/cold restore wall+CPU, memory raw bytes and compressed bytes, count all candidate pair evaluations, model process RSS where available. No paid APIs, GPU, protected key or new runner. Total output <=256KB.
frozen_design.capacity: Candidate at most 144 raw learned bytes of global/core and 16 fixed eight-index adapters plus separate SHA-256 checkpoint bytes. An overflow must abstain/abort atomically. No per-context independent 128-bit law may be stored inside the candidate.
frozen_design.evaluator: Original per-context held parity accuracy from 128 disjoint random intervention masks, 16 contexts, with 32 paid feedback interventions; basis source knowledge from 128 real onehot calls. Stages 1..3 preserve exact earlier predictions; true physical context rules immutable. Original DEV source-headroom audit: strong exact posterior after 12 vs 32 interventions, source-owner held scores read only after both predictions frozen. Report exact strong conventional per-context table, equal-memory same-information sparse delta and Bayesian reference, plus prior forgotten context count after shared changes. Match total CPU/wall; use 10k context-bootstrap draws RNG seed9090 for measured gain.

preregistered_dev_gates.source_identifiability: 32-action true held accuracy >=0.98 and 32 minus 12 same-source posterior held accuracy >=0.05, with no protected cohort; if failing label SOURCE_NO_HEADROOM and do not spend protected science.
preregistered_dev_gates.engineering: all 16 contexts retained bit-exact after each of three globally shared synapse updates; cold SHA restores identical; corrupt snapshot and over-capacity stage4 shock rejected atomically; 144 bytes raw budget kept.
preregistered_dev_gates.science: A must gain >=0.05 held accuracy over strongest equal-information Bayesian and conventional sparse, 95% context bootstrap lower>0, OR tie within 0.005 while recording >=2.0x *whole-process* cost reduction vs both. Failing these means DEV_NO_GO despite engineering ability.

frozen_design.owner_boundary: No protected owner key embedded in source, learned state or workflow. Source-private rule IDs and hidden actual core never given to model; original DEV source-public key means unblinded development, not protected science. Source and model in same Python CI process for DEV only; native owner-first-use must enforce separate evaluator process.
frozen_design.full_native_integration_condition: No main/native changes from a research PR. Only independently replicated out-of-family scientifically qualified gains on untouched owner-first-use with strong fully trained equal-information controls, cold retention and full final dual-OS regression admit a subsequent minimal native model patch after owner authorization.

controls: exact uniform Bayesian posterior over two-flip context model
fully fit conventional per-context GF2 parity/coefficients on the same 32 masked actions and basis observations (abstain if unidentified)
same-capacity conventional sparse two-flip delta rebase
metrics: Per-context 128 held consequence exact accuracy, 16 worlds; Bayes / conventional table / sparse / native paired differences and CI
128 observed global bit outcomes on each of 4 stages, 512 real new-world outcomes, no hidden reads
100% 16×3 old-context held-prediction retention, actual live shared core mutates, fixed 144B raw model
Rebase no wrong writes on stage4 16-flip fixture shock and snapshot tamper reject
Whole-process CPU/wall and compressed versus raw model bytes including Bayesian/comparator cost; 2x or >=5pp over strongest controls, not easy no-compensation negative

classification_rules.supported: Only DEV_MECHANISM_SIGNAL if source gates + all engineering retention/capacity gates PASS. SCIENTIFIC_PASS requires independent protected originally unseen replication, effect over strong trained Bayesian/conventional and native owner acceptance, never from synthetic public DEV.
classification_rules.mixed: Retention/identifiability PASS but ties strong equal-informed sparse/Bayes without >=2x whole-process cost: MIXED_DEV_NO_NATIVE
classification_rules.negative: SOURCE_NO_HEADROOM if <0.05 reference 12-vs-32 gap; or DEV_NO_GO if exact Bayesian/conventional ties and no whole-process 2x, any genuine prior forgetting, over-capacity silent corruption, or source retained accuracy loss.
classification_rules.invalid: Source private key/actual pair transmitted to model, more than 32 context actions or 128 global bit probes per stage, reused held in fit, source/method changed after first score, missing original provenance, or first-use private key accidentally exposed.

prohibited_after_primary_run: post-score revision of algorithm on original consumed DEV
extra paid causal observations or model calls
main merge/accepted ref native integration without separate authoritative checks
preregistration_note: Source-only independent FKP09 research. FKP08 prior versions append-only; FKP09 tests actual core rebase and context compensation. Any exact Bayesian or conventional sparse tie is preserved as a scientific negative rather than hidden.
